exact_statement: For every fixed nonconstant uniform Boolean seed h on n relevant bits, take t tensor copies on D=tn bits, append r=min{s:2^s-s-1>=D} physical parity tags with distinct weight-at-least-two labels, then flip physical zero. The actual resulting G_t on N=D+r bits is prime across every nontrivial coordinate partition, has every Fourier coefficient nonzero and every input relevant, and H(G_t)/I(G_t) tends to H(h)/I(h). Every singleton collision is <=8*2^-N; every pair collision and total of its two merging refunds is <=16*2^-N. Hence the sums over all pairs are each <=16*binom(N,2)*2^-N and tend to zero. For every fixed epsilon>0, the class of prime full-Fourier-support signs with both total pair quantities <=epsilon has exactly the universal extended-real optimal FEI constant, with no factor-three loss. If H(h)-K I(h)>0 at fixed K>=0, every actual singleton and pair child of G_t violates FEI(K) for sufficiently large t. Thus no such admitted root is a minimal K-violator. A compressed actual N=200 certificate from the three-bit point defect at t64,K8/3 verifies a positive root gap and uniformly positive deficits of all individual singleton/pair children, without enumerating its truth table.

exact_statement: For any Boolean core g on D physical uniform bits and maximum block size b with b<=D and r=ceil(2b log2(2D))<=D, a deterministic greedy systematic parity-check code with r tags has minimum spectral distance at least b+1, preserves H(g), and adds at most r Var(g) influence. Every individual restriction of at most b bits preserves entropy and subtracts exactly its queried influence. For a single zero-vertex edit E of any such coded sign on N bits, p=2^-N, epsilon=2p, eta=F(0), each size-a retained row containing one old coefficient c has exact fourth-moment collision (2^a-1)epsilon^2(2^a epsilon-2eta c)^2/(c^2-2eta c epsilon+2^a epsilon^2). Hence C_A(E)<=2^(a+2)p and total C_A through size b is <=4b(2N)^b2^-N. Every fixed nonconstant seed h has actual full-support physically prime representatives E_t with I->0, max influence->0, mean->1 and H/I->H(h)/I(h), using balanced t-copy point activation k=ceil(sqrt(t)), data dimension D_t=tn+1+k, b_t=max(1,floor(sqrt(t)/log2(2D_t)), r_t=ceil(2b_t log2(2D_t)) and the code/edit. Here b_t->infinity and the total collision over every block of size<=b_t tends to0; total A052 pair merging refunds also tends to0. If the seed violates a fixed FEI(K), every individual child of every block of size<=b_t still violates K eventually. For the single seed-independent cutoff q(N)=max(1,floor(cube_root(N))), q(N_t)<=b_t eventually. For every fixed tau,eta,xi>0 the full-support prime class with I,max influence<=tau, mean>=1-eta and total collision through q(N)<=xi has optimal extended-real FEI constant equal to the universal one. It does not admit genuinely K-critical roots through this family. Exact compressed controls cover the original A005 N200 fixture and a new N12470 b4 rare fixture without huge truth-table enumeration. No universal FEI payment is established.
